_note: The PEOPLE YOU ARE GETTING TO KNOW (session P2a, GDD 4.10 decision 6; format in README.md). Sender: circle = an acquaintance (a classmate who arrived with a new class, CircleSystem; thread circle). They ask you out now and then: going is a free evening spent WITH them (shared time grows closeness; three evenings and 50 closeness make a friend) and stay-home costs a little; the third skip in a row and they stop asking. Texts are written for a day ahead ('on {weekday}'), never 'tonight'. Feed messages ask nothing. Ages 14-19.

text: Hi, you're the runner. Our PE teacher said you're properly good. I'm new around here too.
Hey. I saw your name on the results at the school sports day. Fast.
I wrote up the notes from the lesson you missed. I'll put them on the shared drive.
The teacher gave us the homework for Thursday. I've sent you the exercise numbers.
I go past your street after the last lesson on {weekday}. Want to walk together?
Want to get a hot chocolate after school on {weekday}? My treat, and you can talk about running if you like.

replies.label: Sure
replies.result: It was easy to talk. You walked the long way round.

text: I'm doing the maths revision at the library on {weekday}. Want to do it together? It goes faster with two.
Library on {weekday}, two hours of homework and then we're done. Join me?

replies.label: Yes, I'll study with you
replies.hint: your study evening, with {from}; grades ▲ a little
replies.result: You got more done than alone, and had a laugh.

text: A few of us are going for a walk by the lake on {weekday}, after your training. Come along?
I'm taking my dog to the forest path on {weekday} afternoon. Come with us, it's a good loop.

replies.label: I'll come
replies.result: Fresh air, a dog and nobody asking about your times.

text: Board games at mine on {weekday}, some of the others from our class come too. You in?
We're doing a games evening on {weekday}. Snacks included, no pressure.

replies.label: I'm in
replies.result: You stayed for one more round, and then another.
